Shigar.source: naip/models/fusion/crop_plausibility.py -- Week 4 hand-classified agronomic-geography mask (NOT real crop-area data). This district was not matched in the real MNFSR district table (Gilgit-Baltistan/Azad Kashmir, which the MNFSR report does not cover at all). Track G (Week 9) real attempt: Track F's trained crop-share model WAS run on real Sentinel-2 phenology features for this district (real WorldCereal cropland coverage here is only 0.168% of district area -- near-zero, high-altitude terrain) and REJECTED as unreliable, confirmed with you: predicted shares were suspiciously close to the national-mean baseline regardless of real terrain differences, real evidence of tree-model extrapolation failure outside its lowland-plains training domain -- a real z-score input check alone did not catch this, the output implausibility did. See naip/models/crop_classifier_national/gb_ajk_predictions.json for the real rejected prediction and naip/docs/STATUS_WEEK9.md for detail. Stays on the hand-classified mask deliberately, not as an unresolved gap.
